metadata.title: Eventual Monotonicity of the Willmore Energy under Mean Curvature Flow
metadata.abstract: We prove a late-time monotonicity of the Willmore deficit \(\int_{\Sigma}H^2\,d\mu-16\pi\) along the mean curvature flow of smooth closed embedded strictly convex surfaces in \(\mathbb R^3\),which refining the exponential convergence given by Huisken. As a consequence, the Hawking mass is eventually non--decreasing along mean curvature flow. We also discuss totally umbilical solutions in three-dimensional space forms, where the monotonicity directions of the Willmore energy and the Hawking mass depend on the sign of the ambient sectional curvature.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 证明三维欧氏空间中闭嵌入严格凸曲面的平均曲率流，在足够后期具有 Willmore 缺额单调性，从而 Hawking 质量最终非减。
analysis.breakthrough: 将趋圆的定量收敛进一步细化为晚期单调性。
analysis.limitations: 只保证足够后期，不是从初始时刻全程单调；非凸曲面及一般环境未被这一结论覆盖。 数学分析仅依据摘要和评论，未审读完整证明。 AI 披露另见独立全文检索及命中核查记录；未见披露不代表未使用 AI。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。

analysis.priorityReason: 流、几何能量与质量单调性的连接有较高相关性。
